# fictionlit.com

> > A fiction literature platform with privacy-conscious user tracking and cross-browser compatibility.

fictionlit.com is a fiction literature website that prioritizes user privacy while maintaining analytics capabilities through Google Analytics. The site is optimized for major web browsers including Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge, Opera, and Internet Explorer.

## Key Topics

- Privacy Policy
- Data Collection
- Google Analytics
- User Tracking
- Cookies
- Browser Compatibility
- Chrome
- Firefox
- Safari
- Edge
- Alley Co
- Analytics
- Browser Settings
